prerequisite: authorized interactive user and dedicated source
synthetic_test: Start with existing synthetic clipboard marker; start guard without approved policy; verify startup content is not read or cleared; approve monitor then copy a new synthetic marker
required_evidence: anonymous logon target; exact policy and loaded receipt; observed metadata; no raw marker remotely; pre-existing content not captured

synthetic_test: Copy synthetic email or phone text from Word/Excel including formatted cells; verify detected text categories; record mixed HTML/custom formats as partial; observe conditional active-clipboard clear
required_evidence: intent and result same operation; source sequence comparison; selected category; complete/partial capture; app paste result recorded separately; no pre-paste guarantee

prerequisite: approved clear_sensitive and local synthetic HTML page
synthetic_test: Copy synthetic email from a local test page; verify partial representation coverage and conditional clear; test unselected plain text separately
required_evidence: browser version; policy; anonymous sequence/content refs; response and capture gaps; no browsing URL/title/body exported

synthetic_test: Copy synthetic image/file-list/nontext data then verify same-sequence conditional clear; separately test owner-null or unavailable snapshot
required_evidence: unknown content coverage remains unknown; same-sequence/owner check; empty readback only at response instant; no type-safety claim

synthetic_test: Rapidly replace sensitive A with benign B before clearing; verify stale skip; paste immediately to demonstrate possible race; do not assert universal prevention
required_evidence: original/current anonymous sequence refs; no wrong-version clear; capture/notification gap; explicit race outcome

synthetic_test: Hold clipboard open or use delayed rendering; observe busy/unavailable/unknown; release owner and make a new copy
required_evidence: no safe or cleared claim when blocked; bounded source metadata; native call delay remains a coverage gap

prerequisite: new logon sessions and dedicated sources
synthetic_test: Log off/on or switch user; verify SessionRef changes and old approved policy never reactivates even if old capability is replayed
required_evidence: old/new anonymous targets; permanently ended old policy; new independent approval; no cross-user observation

prerequisite: short approved lease and disposable network controls
synthetic_test: Disconnect platform; verify source stops clearing at fixed TTL without extension; restore network and replay metadata twice
required_evidence: stopped/expired state; exact original observation times; stable operation/event IDs; no repeated clear on replay

synthetic_test: Pass a synthetic selected-sensitive text file through Invoke-ScarletClipboardText; verify preflight denial invokes no native writer; separately test ordinary Ctrl+C as reactive-only
required_evidence: controlled_operations preflight blocked fact; unchanged test clipboard; separate session_response events; integration boundary explicit

prerequisite: optional task approved and source configured
synthetic_test: Register limited interactive task; verify no SYSTEM/admin execution; request Remove stop; retain profile and evidence; replay after stop
required_evidence: task principal and limited run level; stop request versus stopped receipt; no history/cloud deletion or content restoration
